description: A narrow guard post behind the Gate's outer slab, all screens and no chairs. A warden construct stands at a lectern of light, reviewing you against a list you aren't on. The turrets' feeds play on the wall: the plaza, the boulevard, your own back.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
